_: The alley's roof run, the first round (BRIEF_ADDENDUM D9, D10; Shared/Attractions/AlleyRoof): the yard house and its tree (tools/bake/alley/Yard) beside the eighteen-lane alley's games wing. Local to world: x = 1300 + X, y = 16.5 + Y, z = -420 - D. Groups: 'routes' draws the roof run's routes (yellow the way up, orange the leap's flight with no key, cyan the vent and rafters that have no building yet); 'squirrels' stands the placeholder squirrel where the motor puts one. Render: the bakes, then lune run tools/review/export.luau --out build/review_roof/scene.json; lune run tools/review/alley_roof.luau; render.py --scene build/review_roof/scene.json --views tools/review/views_alley_roof.json --out build/review_roof. Committed pictures: docs/renders/alley_roof/.
